Name: Abiah, Son of Samuel
Summary: Abiah, Samuel's second son, was made a judge at Beersheba with his brother Joel. Both took bribes and perverted judgment, and Israel cited their failure when demanding a king.
KeyStory: Abiah's corrupt judgeship helped push Israel to ask for a king like the nations.
LifeLesson: Leadership passed down without character becomes the very reason people stop trusting it.
